entries.title: Leviticus 11:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying to them,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'These [are] the animals which you may eat among all the animals that [are] on the earth:

entries.title: Leviticus 11:3
segments: 'Among the animals, whatever divides the hoof, having cloven hooves [and] chewing the cud-that you may eat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:4
segments: 'Nevertheless these you shall not eat among those that chew the cud or those that have cloven hooves: the camel, because it chews the cud but does not have cloven hooves, is unclean to you;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:5
segments: 'the rock hyrax, because it chews the cud but does not have cloven hooves, [is] unclean to you;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:6
segments: 'the hare, because it chews the cud but does not have cloven hooves, [is] unclean to you;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:7
segments: 'and the swine, though it divides the hoof, having cloven hooves, yet does not chew the cud, [is] unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:8
segments: 'Their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch. They [are] unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:9
segments: ¶'These you may eat of all that [are] in the water: whatever in the water has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the rivers-that you may eat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:10
segments: 'But all in the seas or in the rivers that do not have fins and scales, all that move in the water or any living thing which [is] in the water, they [are] an abomination to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:11
segments: 'They shall be an abomination to you; you shall not eat their flesh, but you shall regard their carcasses as an abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:12
segments: 'Whatever in the water does not have fins or scales-that [shall be] an abomination to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:13
segments: 'And these you shall regard as an abomination among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they [are] an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the buzzard,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:14
segments: 'the kite, and the falcon after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:15
segments: 'every raven after its kind,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:16
segments: 'the ostrich, the short-eared owl, the sea gull, and the hawk after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:17
segments: 'the little owl, the fisher owl, and the screech owl;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:18
segments: 'the white owl, the jackdaw, and the carrion vulture;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:19
segments: 'the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:20
segments: ¶'All flying insects that creep on [all] fours [shall be] an abomination to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:21
segments: 'Yet these you may eat of every flying insect that creeps on [all] fours: those which have jointed legs above their feet with which to leap on the earth.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:22
segments: 'These you may eat: the locust after its kind, the destroying locust after its kind, the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:23
segments: 'But all [other] flying insects which have four feet [shall be] an abomination to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:24
segments: 'By these you shall become unclean; whoever touches the carcass of any of them shall be unclean until evening;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:25
segments: 'whoever carries part of the carcass of any of them shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening:

entries.title: Leviticus 11:26
segments: '[The carcass] of any animal which divides the foot, but is not cloven-hoofed or does not chew the cud, [is] unclean to you. Everyone who touches it shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:27
segments: 'And whatever goes on its paws, among all kinds of animals that go on [all] fours, those [are] unclean to you. Whoever touches any such carcass shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:28
segments: 'Whoever carries [any such] carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. It [is] unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:29
segments: 'These also [shall be] unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the mole, the mouse, and the large lizard after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:30
segments: 'the gecko, the monitor lizard, the sand reptile, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:31
segments: 'These [are] unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:32
segments: 'Anything on which [any] of them falls, when they are dead shall be unclean, whether [it is] any item of wood or clothing or skin or sack, whatever item [it is], in which [any] work is done, it must be put in water. And it shall be unclean until evening; then it shall be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:33
segments: 'Any earthen vessel into which [any] of them falls you shall break; and whatever [is] in it shall be unclean:

entries.title: Leviticus 11:34
segments: 'in such a vessel, any edible food upon which water falls becomes unclean, and any drink that may be drunk from it becomes unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:35
segments: 'And everything on which [a part] of [any such] carcass falls shall be unclean; [whether it is] an oven or cooking stove, it shall be broken down; [for] they [are] unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:36
segments: 'Nevertheless a spring or a cistern, [in which there is] plenty of water, shall be clean, but whatever touches any such carcass becomes unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:37
segments: 'And if a part of [any such] carcass falls on any planting seed which is to be sown, it [remains] clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:38
segments: 'But if water is put on the seed, and if [a part] of [any such] carcass falls on it, it [becomes] unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:39
segments: 'And if any animal which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:40
segments: 'He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:41
segments: 'And every creeping thing that creeps on the earth [shall be] an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:42
segments: 'Whatever crawls on its belly, whatever goes on [all] fours, or whatever has many feet among all creeping things that creep on the earth-these you shall not eat, for they [are] an abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:43
segments: ¶'You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps; nor shall you make yourselves unclean with them, lest you be defiled by them.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:44
segments: 'For I [am] the LORD your God. You shall therefore consecrate yourselves, and you shall be holy; for I [am] holy. Neither shall you defile yourselves with any creeping thing that creeps on the earth.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:45
segments: 'For I [am] the LORD who brings you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I [am] holy.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:46
segments: 'This [is] the law of the animals and the birds and every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:47
segments: 'to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the animal that may be eaten and the animal that may not be eaten.'"
